name: developer
description: Engineering team toolkit for Claude Code. Coding-quality skills used by the dev subagents: skill-frontend-web (HTML/CSS/SCSS/Tailwind/JS/TS/React), skill-backend (API/server design + controller/service/repository layering), skill-sql (schema/query/security/migration), and skill-software-testing (test design + UAT docs + QA loop). Also bundles skill-python (venv-per-project), skill-fastapi, and ui-ux-pro-max (design intelligence) — revised to the kob theme. Reuses the security plugin. Subagents: subagent-fullstack (builds per proposal/architecture using the coding skills) and subagent-qa-tester (test + UAT + security, with a PM-mediated fix loop back to fullstack).
